text: Backend read-only project mode: refuse every mutation and report it
description: A project opened read-only must reject all writes at one choke point, with a clear 'read-only' error, and expose its read-only state to the frontend (e.g. in project meta/state). Generalize the existing guard that already refuses writes to projects from a newer Aimparency version (assertWritableBowman), so both cases share one mechanism and one message.
